name: AGB Web Designs Student Project Portfolio
author: agbwebdesigns

sections.description:
Student Project Portfolio helps students turn coursework, capstones, research, and personal projects into a professional portfolio without manually designing every project entry.

Features include:
* Unlimited project entries.
* A structured Projects post type.
* Built-in student-project fields with per-project visibility controls.
* Profile information for name, headline, introduction, contact details, LinkedIn, GitHub, resume, location, and profile photo.
* Visual, non-destructive profile-photo crop editor with display size and shape controls.
* Per-project field visibility toggles so individual projects can omit fields without deleting their values.
* Project Categories for organizing projects by discipline or type.
* Frontend project search that matches project titles and Technologies Used, plus category filtering.
* Complete Portfolio mode that automatically creates a portfolio page.
* Projects Only mode for use with Gutenberg, Elementor, Beaver Builder, or another page-building workflow.
* Student Project Grid Gutenberg block.
* [agbsp_student_projects] shortcode.
* [agbsp_student_portfolio] shortcode.
* Responsive project cards and a polished default portfolio style.
* Schema.org JSON-LD for the student profile and published projects.
* Semantic Person and CreativeWork markup in Complete Portfolio output.
* Public machine-readable portfolio REST endpoint, with email/phone exposure opt-in and off by default.
* Career Metadata for target roles, skills, institution, degree/program, graduation, and availability.
* Optional public career-profile REST feed for future recruiter/search integrations.

Projects -> Settings -> General includes controls for portfolio mode, project-grid columns, Course visibility, and Technologies visibility. Projects -> Settings -> Career Metadata stores structured career information and controls the optional public career feed. Projects -> Settings -> About shows plugin version, AGB Web Designs branding, developer credit, update guidance, and core plugin details.

An optional Student Project Portfolio Pro add-on adds custom fields, field reordering, and advanced visual customization while this plugin remains fully functional on its own.
sections.changelog:
3.0.0

  • Renamed the plugin and permalink namespace to use the distinctive AGB Web Designs brand.
  • Re-prefixed WordPress declarations, stored-data keys, AJAX actions, asset handles, and shortcodes with the unique AGBSP prefix.
  • Hardened JSON-LD output encoding for safe script embedding.
  • Updated the WordPress.org contributor username.

2.7.4

  • Refactored Complete Portfolio project-grid rendering to satisfy WordPress Plugin Check without changing frontend behavior.

2.7.3

  • Added WordPress and PHP minimum-version headers to the main plugin file.
  • Updated submission documentation and current feature descriptions.
  • Fixed the normalized what_you_learned REST API alias.
  • Preserved frontend filtering data attributes in Complete Portfolio mode while documenting the renderer’s internal escaping.

2.7.2

  • Adjusted project visibility and ordering input handling for WordPress Plugin Check compatibility.

2.7.1

  • Improved WordPress coding-standards compliance for sanitization, escaping, internationalization comments, and URL parsing.
  • Updated the readme Tested up to value for the current WordPress release.

2.7.0

  • Added hierarchical Project Categories.
  • Added frontend project search by project title and Technologies Used.
  • Added category filtering and filter reset controls.
  • Added project categories to the public portfolio REST API.

2.6.2

  • Renamed Career Data to Career Metadata throughout the Free settings interface.

2.6.1

  • About now displays the active Pro add-on version when Pro is enabled.

2.6.0

  • Moved Career Metadata and the optional public career-profile feed into Free.
  • Added migration from legacy Pro career data.
  • Added machine-discovery metadata for the public career-profile feed.

2.5.3

  • Fixed Pro add-on status detection on the About tab.

2.5.0

  • Make Minimal the default Complete Portfolio style.
  • Show the Free style selector with Pro preset previews and an upgrade note.
  • Add a portfolio-style filter so the Pro add-on can switch the underlying presentation cleanly.

2.4.0

  • Added drag-and-drop project reordering to the Projects list.
  • Added accessible move up/down controls as a non-drag alternative.
  • Project grids, complete portfolios, and the public portfolio API now share the saved project order.

2.3.1

  • Updated plugin branding to AGB Web Designs, with Adam Bennett credited as developer.

2.3.0

  • Added an About settings tab with version, creator, license, Pro status, update guidance, and the public portfolio API endpoint.
  • Added a direct link to the standard WordPress Updates screen.
  • Removed stale documentation references to the former Free Fields tab.

2.2.2

  • Simplified Free settings by removing the global Fields tab; built-in fields are always available and can be shown/hidden per project.
  • The General tab now displays only the shortcode that matches the selected Portfolio Mode.

2.2.1

  • Omit empty normalized project properties from the public portfolio API for cleaner output.
  • Correct the internal plugin version constant to match the release version.

2.2.0

  • Decoded HTML entities in public API titles, labels, profile text, and field values.
  • Added stable machine-friendly project properties for course, semester, role, technologies, problem, solution, result, what_you_learned, GitHub, and demo URLs.
  • Technologies are now exposed as a normalized array while the existing generic fields object remains available for backward compatibility.

2.1.0

  • Added Schema.org Person + CreativeWork JSON-LD for portfolio pages.
  • Added semantic structured markup to Complete Portfolio and project cards.
  • Added a public machine-readable portfolio API at /wp-json/agb-web-designs-student-project-portfolio/v1/portfolio.
  • Added an opt-in control for exposing email and phone in machine-readable data; contact exposure is off by default.

2.0.0

  • Moved custom field creation and field reordering to the optional Pro add-on.
  • Free continues to provide unlimited projects and all built-in project fields.
  • Preserves legacy custom-field definitions during upgrade so Pro can migrate/use them without data loss.

1.4.2

  • Added a visible Technologies Used label to project output.
  • Improved vertical spacing between structured project fields.

1.4.1

  • Fixed frontend rendering so Role, Problem, Solution / Approach, Result, and What You Learned display when enabled and visible for a project.

1.4.0

  • Added per-project visibility toggles beside every built-in and custom project field.
  • Hidden fields keep their saved values and can be turned back on later.
  • Project cards now honor individual field visibility in addition to the global Fields configuration.

1.3.0

  • Added a visual profile image crop editor with drag-to-reposition, zoom, rotation, display size, and shape controls.
  • Cropped profile images are saved as new Media Library attachments; original uploads remain untouched.
  • Removed the old focal-point sliders from the Profile settings screen.

1.2.1

  • Fixed profile-photo focal-point preview so 0 and negative values update live correctly.
  • Extended horizontal and vertical image positioning from -100% to 200%.
  • Admin preview now uses the same large image source and display rules as the public portfolio for closer one-to-one positioning.

1.2.0

  • Added horizontal and vertical focal-point controls for profile photos.
  • Added an 80–240 px profile-photo size control.
  • Added Circle, Rounded, and Square profile-photo shapes.
  • Added a live Profile settings preview without destructively cropping the Media Library image.

1.1.0

  • Added WordPress Media Library selection for profile images.
  • Added uploaded resume support for PDF, DOC, and DOCX files, including public view/download links.

1.0.0

  • Removed the former three-project creation cap. Projects are now unlimited.
  • Removed payment and license-gating code from the free core plugin.
  • Kept Complete Portfolio and Projects Only modes fully functional.
  • Kept profile, custom fields, Gutenberg block, shortcodes, and generated portfolio page in the free plugin.
  • Standardized the free Complete Portfolio output on one polished default style.
  • Prepared the core plugin for an optional Pro styling add-on.

0.5.2

  • Added distinct typography treatments to the original Complete Portfolio style presets.

0.5.0

  • Added Complete Portfolio and Projects Only modes.
  • Complete Portfolio mode automatically creates a Portfolio page using [agbsp_student_portfolio].
  • Added Profile settings for personal/contact information and profile links.

0.2.0

  • Added configurable built-in fields and custom project fields.

0.1.0

  • Initial MVP.
